title: Contract Pricing Agreement: Price Claims on Protected Substitute Lines
content:
## Price claims on protected substitute lines — Contract Pricing Agreement

**The rule.** This policy works out the contract price claim the customer files on a substitute line billed during its price protection. For a substitute claim this policy works out, and only for such a claim, the claim amount is the one this policy works out; every other claim amount is still the billed unit price less the unit price the agreement sets for the line's ship date, times the quantity billed, rounded half up to the cent, and the agreement in force is still the one whose status covered the ship date, not the one in force on the claim date. A shipment outside this policy's scope is not claimed under it.

**When the claim is fixed.** A claim on a substitute line billed during its protection is fixed only after the records carry the substitute's protection line. The claim figure therefore rests on that protection line being on the records.

**What the filing does.** The customer's authorized contact files one claim line on the agreement's price claim records for the invoice and item named. It carries the quantity claimed, the unit price billed, the unit price the agreement sets, the claim amount, the filing date (the day of filing), a pending status and a newly issued claim reference. The customer receives the claim reference to track the claim.

### Invocation

Filing is the customer's own act: the agent unlocks `file_contract_price_claim_992a36b2` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `pricing_agreement_id` | Reference number of the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement, as the agent reads it from the agreement lookup and hands it to the customer (id) |
| `invoice_number` | The invoice number exactly as printed on the customer's invoice, copied character for character |
| `sku` | The Corbett item number of the billed line exactly as printed on the invoice, copied character for character |
| `quantity` | The quantity claimed, in integer selling units, as the agent hands it to the customer |
| `billed_unit_price` | The unit price billed on the line, USD, 4 decimal places, as printed on the invoice |
| `contract_unit_price` | The unit price the agreement sets for the line, USD, 4 decimal places, as the agent hands it to the customer |
| `claim_amount` | The claim amount, USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, as the agent hands it to the customer |

### Return

On success: `status` ("filed" when the claim line was written), `price_claim_id` (reference number of the new claim line), `claim_reference` (the claim reference issued), `claim_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `outcome` (pending, the status of a claim awaiting its decision).
